content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: overtime for 12 general agents (11:30-15:30) plus chat deflection and IVR callback on both queues, predicted 84.1% service level for 11:00-19:45 at ₹6,804.","why":"Calls are running about 25% above forecast on both queues with no identified cause: no incidents, no marketing sends, normal absences, and all call reasons up evenly. Doing nothing leaves the window at 72.1%, with general at 63.8%. P3 is the cheapest plan that reaches the 80% target with no policy violations. It predicts 84.1% overall (payments 87.7%, general 80.6%) and cuts abandons from 5.9% to 3.2%. Overtime runs as two 2-hour blocks of 12 general agents. Chat deflection takes 20% of balance and payment-status enquiries, and callback runs on both queues from 11:00 to 15:00.","trade_offs":["P2 (₹1,764) is ₹5,040 cheaper but just misses the target at 79.2%, and general stays at 71.4%.","P1 (₹900) only reaches 73.2%, barely better than no action.","P4 (₹11,700) gives more headroom at 87.1% and 2.7% abandons, but costs ₹4,896 more and needs 20 general plus 5 payments overtime volunteers.","P3 does not pull agents from payments, so the other queue is not put at risk. Payments improves to 87.7%."],"watch":"General is predicted at 80.6%, only just above target. If overtime uptake falls short of 12 agents, or volume keeps climbing beyond the current +31-36%, general will drop below 80%. Be ready to step up toward P4. The cause of the surge is unknown, so keep checking for a late incident or marketing explanation."}
